verdicts.reason: A: the headline sits right on top of the shrunken shoe and circle, so the text collides with a busy image. The NEW VIDEO badge overlaps the circle, everything is crammed into the top quarter, and about 60% of the canvas below is empty purple. B is a proper vertical restack (brand and badge, then headline, then hero shoe, then subline) with nothing colliding and the brand intact. Its flaws are minor: 'Full review inside.' is jammed between the circle and the bottom edge, and the circle and shoe fill the lower area a bit tightly.
